title: 人形机器人出货占全球97%，中国领跑科技竞赛
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Chinese companies like Unitry and Agibok are all facing US rivals like Tesla when it comes to shipments.
segments.zh: 中国公司如优必选和智元在出货量上正面对特斯拉等美国对手。

segments.en: The answer could be here at the World Robocombs in Beijing.
segments.zh: 答案可能就在北京的世界机器人大会上。

segments.en: I've seen robots carrying heavy boxes and sorting them.
segments.zh: 我看到了搬运重箱和分拣的机器人。

segments.en: They actually pick up their technology and put their washing machines.
segments.zh: 它们实际上会拿起技术，把洗衣机放好。

segments.en: And here we have robots that actually put clothes and plastic bags and containers.
segments.zh: 这里还有机器人会整理衣物、塑料袋和容器。

segments.en: It's not just rare herbs and EVs anymore.
segments.zh: 现在不只是稀土和电动车了。

segments.en: China could take a domineering position in one more field, humanoid robots.
segments.zh: 中国可能在另一个领域占据主导地位：人形机器人。

segments.en: The country's humanoid robot makers commanded more than 97% of global shipments in the first half of the year, giving it an early lead against US rivals in the rapidly growing field.
segments.zh: 今年上半年，中国人形机器人制造商占全球出货量的97%以上，在这个快速增长的领域领先美国对手。

segments.en: The question now is, can China take these entertaining show pieces and turn them into machines with real life uses?
segments.zh: 现在的问题是，中国能否将这些娱乐展示品变成有实际用途的机器？

segments.en: President Xi Jinping is looking to the robotics industry to help beat the US in a global tech race.
segments.zh: 习近平主席希望机器人产业帮助中国在全球科技竞赛中战胜美国。

segments.en: And it appears to be working for now, but it won't be all smooth sailing for China.
segments.zh: 目前看来效果不错，但中国的前路并非一帆风顺。

segments.en: The US, for example, has recently introduced curbs on foreign-made robots, citing national security concerns.
segments.zh: 例如，美国近期以国家安全为由，对国外制造的机器人实施限制。

segments.en: That's not stopping Beijing from making an audacious bet on email robots.
segments.zh: 但这并未阻止北京在机器人领域的大胆押注。

segments.en: But policy and funding support from Beijing and robots like these have commercial value.
segments.zh: 北京的政策与资金支持，以及这些机器人的商业价值，都是推动因素。

segments.en: China's humanoid robot industry could make the mainstream much faster than expected.
segments.zh: 中国人形机器人产业可能比预期更快进入主流。
